metadata.description: Solana AI Kit — Claude Code configuration for Solana development: specialized agents, workflow commands, go-to-market skills, MCP servers, and hooks.

plugins.name: solana-ai-kit
plugins.description: Core Solana dev kit: specialized agents, workflow commands, skills, MCP servers, and dev hooks. Installs the safe-ai-skill security firewall as a dependency. (Full install via install.sh adds the project CLAUDE.md, the permissions/sandbox policy, and the ext/ skill packs: core by default, extensions on demand.)

plugins.name: safe-ai-skill
plugins.description: Security firewall and supply-chain verifier (hooks): gates mainnet, value-moving and authority actions and secret reads, and pins installed skills and MCPs at session start. Core part of the kit: solana-ai-kit depends on it.
